meta.name: ponytail-audit
meta.description: Whole-repo audit for over-engineering. Like ponytail-review, but scans the entire codebase instead of a diff: a ranked list of what to delete, simplify, or replace with stdlib/native equivalents. Use when the user says "audit this codebase", "audit for over-engineering", "what can I delete from this repo", "find bloat", "ponytail-audit", or "/ponytail-audit". One-shot report, does not apply fixes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描整个代码库，找出可删除或简化的过度工程代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你觉得代码库日渐臃肿，想找到可以删减的地方
copy.tagline_en: Scan the entire codebase to find over-engineered code that can be deleted or simplified
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you think your codebase is bloated and want to cut it down

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会扫描整个代码库,产出按删减收益排序的清单:标出可删除、简化或改用标准库/平台原生功能的内容,附路径与净减行数/依赖;只出报告,不改代码。
howto.when: 当你说“audit this codebase”或“audit for over-engineering”等,或输入“/ponytail-audit”时触发。

say.text: audit this codebase,找出能删的过度设计。
say.note: 会扫描全仓库并给出删减建议。

say.text: 用/ponytail-audit扫描整个仓库,找出可删内容。
say.note: 结果按删减收益从大到小排列。

say.text: audit for over-engineering,只要排名清单。
say.note: 会忽略正确性/性能,只查过度设计。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude scans the whole repo and outputs a ranked list of what to delete, simplify, or replace with stdlib/native equivalents, with paths and net line/dependency counts. It only reports; it does not apply fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “audit this codebase” or “audit for over-engineering”, or type “/ponytail-audit”.

say_en.text: audit this codebase, find over-engineering to cut.
say_en.note: Scans the whole repo and suggests removals.

say_en.text: Run /ponytail-audit on this repo and list what can go.
say_en.note: Output is ranked by biggest cut first.

say_en.text: audit for over-engineering, ranked list only.
